text: The purpose of this report is to advise Toronto City Council, pursuant to Chapter 195 of the Toronto Municipal Code, Procurement, Section 195-7.5.B, of a non-competitive contract with Grascan Construction Ltd., (Grascan) for emergency soffit shoring repairs to F.G. Gardiner Expressway, for a total value of $4,275,568 net of all taxes and charges ($4,350,818 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries). The issuance of this non-competitive contract was a matter of urgency - annual inspections revealed severe soffit concrete deterioration (spalls) at various areas along the Gardiner. These deteriorated areas compromise the deck’s load-carrying capacity and pose a risk of punch-through failures from vehicular traffic above, presenting a serious safety hazard to motorists and travelers below.
